root.label: Member functions and this
root.note: A non-static member function takes the object as one extra parameter.

children.label: Implicit object parameter
children.note: Overload resolution treats the object as an argument bound to a reference parameter.

children.label: cv-qualifiers
children.note: f() const gives the parameter type const X&, so const objects call only const overloads.

children.label: Rvalue exception
children.note: Without a ref-qualifier, an rvalue may bind to the non-const implicit object parameter.

children.label: this
children.note: A prvalue pointer to the cv-qualified class, pointing at the object parameter.

children.label: Ref-qualifiers
children.note: & and && make the object parameter an lvalue or rvalue reference (C++11).

children.label: && accessors
children.note: Let rvalue objects give up their members, as optional::value() && does.

children.label: *this stays lvalue
children.note: Inside a && function, *this and named members are lvalues; use std::move(*this).

children.label: No mixing
children.note: A ref-qualified overload cannot coexist with an unqualified one for the same object type.

children.label: Explicit object parameter
children.note: C++23 deducing this: the object is the first parameter, written with this in front.

children.label: No implicit this
children.note: The body has no this pointer; members are reached as self.member.

children.label: Static type deduction
children.note: Self deduces from the static type of the object expression, never the dynamic type.

children.label: Restrictions
children.note: Cannot be static, virtual, or cv- or ref-qualified.

children.label: Plain function pointer
children.note: &S::f has type R(*)(S&...), not a pointer to member.

children.label: Recursive lambdas
children.note: [](this auto self, int n) can call self without std::function.

children.label: Static members
children.note: Belong to the class, with no object parameter and no this.

children.label: Static member functions
children.note: No this, no cv- or ref-qualifiers; still callable as obj.f().

children.label: Static call operators
children.note: C++23 allows static operator() and static operator[].

children.label: Inline static data
children.note: inline static members (C++17) are defined in the class body.

children.label: constexpr implies inline
children.note: static constexpr data members are inline since C++17; static const ones are not.

children.label: Class body rules
children.note: Where definitions live and what names they can see.

children.label: In-class means inline
children.note: Member functions defined in the class are inline, unless attached to a named module.

children.label: Complete-class context
children.note: Bodies, default arguments, noexcept and default member initializers see later members.

children.label: Signatures see backwards
children.note: Return and parameter types only see names declared earlier in the class.

children.label: this in lambdas
children.note: Lambdas reach members through a captured this.

children.label: [this]
children.note: Captures the pointer; the lambda dangles if it outlives the object.

children.label: [*this]
children.note: C++17: copies the whole object into the closure.

children.label: [=] deprecation
children.note: Implicit this capture through [=] is deprecated in C++20; write [=, this].
